title: Tulsa Crime Data Open Records Request- NIBRS

communications.communication:
Dear Open Records Coordinator,

I am writing on behalf of the Data Acquisition Lab to formally request access to public records under the Oklahoma Open Records Act, 51 § 24A.1 et seq. We are requesting anonymized incident-level violent crime information for data visualization and analysis, which will enable a more meaningful understanding of community-level trends. We plan to request this information on a quarterly basis going forward.

I am specifically requesting incident-level crime data from the Tulsa Police Department's UCR Part 1 and 2 offense records, from January 1st, 2019, to December 31, 2023. 

Please provide the following fields for each incident:
-Identifier: Case/Report Number
-Date/Time: Date of Offense & Time of Offense
-Offense Detail: Offense Code, Offense Description, Offense Category, Domestic Violence Flag (if applicable), & Weapon (if available)
-Location : Block-Level Address (e.g., “1200 BLK MAIN ST”), or Street Address, or Geographic Coordinates (latitude and longitude- rounded to three decimal places if necessary)

Please provide the requested data in electronic format, if possible, and notify me in advance of any necessary clarification or related costs exceeding $100.

If certain records or portions of records are exempt from disclosure, please provide a written explanation of the specific exemption(s) and release any non-exempt portions of the requested records.

Thank you for your attention to this request. If you have any questions or require further information, please feel free to contact me. 

Sincerely,
The Data Acquisition Lab

title: FOIA Request — RFP #23.09 Strategic Plan Facilitator: proposals, evaluation scores and contract

communications.communication:
Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act (MCL 15.231 et seq.), I request copies of the following records relating to Rochester Community Schools RFP #23.09, "Strategic Plan Facilitator" (2023; awarded to G&D Associates). The date range for this request is January 1, 2023 through September 30, 2026.

In this request, a reference to any record includes that record under any title the District uses for it; where a title differs, I request the record that serves that function.

1. The complete solicitation document for RFP #23.09, including all addenda and the evaluation criteria and weights.
2. The tabulation or summary of all proposals received (also called a bid abstract or proposal register), showing all proposers and all proposed prices, in its native spreadsheet format if maintained as one.
3. All evaluation and scoring records, including scoring sheets (also called evaluation forms, rating sheets, or scorecards), individual and consensus scores, rubrics, evaluator comments and worksheets (also called committee notes), and any interview or presentation scores. This includes evaluation records maintained in any e-procurement or agenda-management system the District uses.
4. All proposals submitted in response to RFP #23.09, including technical and cost proposals. If the volume is large, I prioritize: (a) the proposal of G&D Associates, and (b) the proposal of FourPoint Education Partners.
5. The executed contract (also called the agreement or professional services agreement) with G&D Associates, including scope of work, final price, term, and renewal options, plus all amendments, change orders, and extensions.
6. The board agenda item and supporting materials approving this award, including the funding source.
7. Line-item invoices submitted by, and payments (also called payment records or disbursement records) made to, G&D Associates under this contract, from the contract start through September 30, 2026.
8. The final deliverable(s) (also called work products or final reports) produced under this contract, including the adopted strategic plan document.

Please provide records in electronic format (searchable PDF or native files) where available, and produce records on a rolling basis as they are located and reviewed, beginning with the tabulation, scoring records, and executed contract, rather than holding all records until the full set is complete. If a responsive record is held by a third-party portal or vendor on the District's behalf, please produce it or identify where it is publicly posted. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific statutory exemption and release all reasonably segregable portions. Pursuant to MCL 15.234, please provide an itemized fee estimate if fees will exceed $50, and contact me before processing if fees are expected to exceed $50; I do not authorize fees above $50 without my prior written approval.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Felipe Acano

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: Data Sharing - LASD
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I’m researching how Los Angeles County law enforcement agencies share CAD, RMS, and JMS data with other agencies. That includes regional systems, national exchanges such as the FBI’s N-DEX and LInX, and private platforms such as SoundThinking’s CrimeTracer and LexisNexis’s Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC, also called the Public Safety Data Exchange or PSDEX).

LASD described its own participation in a 2023 training: “The CrimeTracer Application provides Detectives, Crime Analysts, Investigators and Patrol Personnel with access to Law Enforcement data shared by over 47 agencies within Los Angeles County. Within CrimeTracer, Law Enforcement Personnel also have access to additional Law Enforcement data shared by other agencies outside of Los Angeles County and California.” I am also aware of a related request, reference number 25-4089CO. If records responsive to this request were already produced under that number, please include them here.

I am requesting the following records, from January 1, 2015 through the date of fulfillment:

1) Any contract, addendum, amendment, or terms of service with a private company that governs sharing LASD data with that company or through its platform. This includes agreements with SoundThinking (formerly ShotSpotter) or its predecessor for CrimeTracer, and with LexisNexis Risk Solutions for Accurint or AVCC, including any “AVCC XML Addendum” or Schedule A that specifies which data LASD contributes.
2) Any data sharing agreement, MOU, or other agreement under which LASD shares data in bulk with any public or private data exchange.

If any record is withheld in whole or in part, please follow Government Code §7922.000 and §7922.540. Cite the specific exemption that applies to each record, identify the record by title and page count, and give the name and title of the person responsible for the decision. Under §7922.525, please release all reasonably segregable portions of any record that is partially exempt. If a request item is unclear or too broad, I’m happy to narrow it under §7922.600 and would appreciate a call or email before any denial.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: California City Detention Center - Email Request (Department of Industrial Relations, Division of Occupational Safety and Health)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1) Domains: all emails between your agency and "@ice.dhs.gov", "@hsi.dhs.gov", "@dhs.gov", "@associates.ice.dhs.gov", or "@corecivic.com". Timeframe: August 1, 2026 through October 22, 2026.

2) Include: emails, attachments, inline and embedded images, links, and the subject and to/from/cc lines. Please provide the original emails in full.

3) Format: if possible, please provide the original electronic files (.eml, .msg, .mbox, .pst, or a similar native format) so the integrity of the original messages is preserved. If native files are not available, a PDF export is acceptable.

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

an export of public records concerning municipal water utility accounts that have experienced service disruptions due to non-payment or fire.
Specifically, I am requesting an electronic data export (preferably in CSV, Excel, or structured text format) of all residential and commercial water utility accounts that meet any of the following criteria within the past 120 days:
1. Accounts that have been physically disconnected or shut off for non-payment or fire.
2. Accounts where the meter has been locked out or pulled due to delinquency or fire.
3. Accounts currently on the final "scheduled for disconnect" or delinquency termination list.
To the extent available within your utility management system, please ensure the exported data fields include:
• Full Service Address (Street Number, Street Name, Unit, City, Zip Code)
• Disconnect, Lockout, or Shut-off Date
• Current Status Code / Account Status (e.g., Closed, Disconnected, Pending Shut-off)
Please note that I am not requesting individual customer payment histories, bank details, or Social Security numbers. If your department considers the outstanding dollar balance or individual customer names to be confidential or exempt under privacy guidelines, please redact only those specific fields and provide the rest of the structural location and status data.
As an electronic database export is requested, please provide these records in their native electronic format to avoid unnecessary printing or scanning fees.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys

communications.communication:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I request public records concerning residential structure fires within the City of Norman.

Specifically, I request a digital spreadsheet, report, or incident log identifying all residential properties where the Norman Fire Department responded to a structure fire from January 1, 2026, through the date this request is processed.

To limit clerical search time, please provide the information in its existing electronic format, such as Excel, CSV, or a text file. Please include the following available fields:

- Incident type
- Description or estimated extent of property damage

I am requesting a summary list or incident log rather than complete individual incident reports, photographs, medical information, 911 recordings, or investigative files.

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: SOFNEX
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Emails, email attachments, calendar entries, and meeting invitations sent or received between July 1, 2017, and March 31, 2019, by U.S. Border Patrol personnel, including the account of Program Manager Kirby D. Klein, that include the word or phrase "SOFNEX" or "SOF NEX."
- Emails, email attachments, calendar entries, and meeting invitations sent or received between July 1, 2017, and March 31, 2019, by any other U.S. Customs and Border Protection office, including the Office of the Commissioner and the Office of Acquisition, that include the word or phrase "SOFNEX" or "SOF NEX."
- Any registration, travel, or attendance records from July 1, 2017, through March 31, 2019, for CBP personnel attending or presenting at an event called "SOFNEX."

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
